# The OLDEST Home Assistant the integration claims to support, for the job "Compat smoke
# (minimum Home Assistant)" in ci.yml: exactly the release hacs.json names (2026.1.0), which is
# what pytest-homeassistant-custom-component 0.13.305 pins, with the test tooling of that time.
# Python 3.13 is its minimum.
#
# Install with:  pip install -r .github/compat/min-ha.txt
#
# This file lives outside the repository root so that Dependabot does not try to bump a deliberately
# old Home Assistant. Raise it by hand, once a year, in the pull request that raises the minimum in
# hacs.json and says so in CHANGELOG.md under "Adopter action".
pytest-homeassistant-custom-component==0.13.305
